note: REAL effective dates for changelog entries. A snapshot diff only knows the date a change was first OBSERVED (often a backfill date, so many changes pile onto one day). Each rule pins the true date of a change. A rule matches a change when every field it specifies is equal; unspecified fields are wildcards. First matching rule wins. The original observed date is preserved as observed_on for the tooltip. Leave date as "" until you can source it; blank rules are ignored, so the change keeps its observed date. Matchable fields: kind, provider, plan, model (the NEW model for model_changed), from, to.
